mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.user_id AS "userId", o.status AS "orderStatus", encode(i.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", i.sku_name AS "skuName", i.quantity AS "quantity", i.created_at AS "itemCreatedAt", i.id AS "itemId" FROM trade_order o LEFT JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_no = o.order_no WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.created_at ASC NULLS LAST, i.id ASC NULLS LAST

WITH raw AS ( SELECT order_no, user_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{ordersJson} AS jsonb)) AS item( order_no text, user_id bigint ) ), target_orders AS ( SELECT DISTINCT order_no, user_id FROM raw WHERE order_no IS NOT NULL AND btrim(order_no) <> '' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id > 0 ) SELECT o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.user_id AS "userId", o.status AS "orderStatus", encode(i.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", i.sku_name AS "skuName", i.quantity AS "quantity", i.created_at AS "itemCreatedAt", i.id AS "itemId" FROM target_orders target INNER JOIN trade_order o ON o.order_no = target.order_no AND o.user_id = target.user_id AND o.status = 'PAID' INNER JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_no = o.order_no ORDER BY o.order_no ASC, i.created_at ASC, i.id ASC

WITH raw_units AS ( SELECT delivery_id_hex, order_no, user_id, sku_id_hex, sku_name, unit_index FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS item( delivery_id_hex text, order_no text, user_id bigint, sku_id_hex text, sku_name text, unit_index integer ) ), raw_orders AS ( SELECT DISTINCT order_no, user_id FROM raw_units WHERE order_no IS NOT NULL AND btrim(order_no) <> '' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id > 0 ), advisory_locks AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(order_no, 0)) AS locked FROM raw_orders ORDER BY order_no ), lock_guard AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS locked_count FROM advisory_locks ), request_units AS ( SELECT decode(raw.delivery_id_hex, 'hex') AS delivery_id, raw.order_no, raw.user_id, decode(raw.sku_id_hex, 'hex') AS sku_id, raw.sku_id_hex, raw.sku_name, raw.unit_index FROM raw_units raw CROSS JOIN lock_guard WHERE raw.delivery_id_hex ~ '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{32}$' AND raw.order_no IS NOT NULL AND btrim(raw.order_no) <> '' AND raw.user_id IS NOT NULL AND raw.user_id > 0 AND raw.sku_id_hex ~ '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{32}$' AND raw.unit_index > 0 ), requested AS ( SELECT order_no, user_id, sku_id, sku_id_hex, MAX(sku_name) AS sku_name, COUNT(*)::int AS required_count FROM request_units GROUP BY order_no, user_id, sku_id, sku_id_hex ), existing AS ( SELECT requested.order_no, requested.user_id, requested.sku_id, COUNT(delivery.id)::int AS existing_count FROM requested LEFT JOIN order_card_secret_delivery delivery ON delivery.order_no = requested.order_no AND delivery.user_id = requested.user_id AND delivery.sku_id = requested.sku_id AND delivery.status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY requested.order_no, requested.user_id, requested.sku_id ), needed_units AS ( SELECT request_units.* FROM request_units INNER JOIN existing ON existing.order_no = request_units.order_no AND existing.user_id = request_units.user_id AND existing.sku_id = request_units.sku_id WHERE request_units.unit_index > existing.existing_count ), needed_ranked AS ( SELECT needed_units.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY needed_units.sku_id ORDER BY needed_units.order_no ASC, needed_units.user_id ASC, needed_units.unit_index ASC ) AS sku_need_rank FROM needed_units ), required_by_sku AS ( SELECT sku_id, COUNT(*)::int AS required_count FROM needed_ranked GROUP BY sku_id ), locked_cards AS ( SELECT picked.id, picked.sku_id, picked.created_at FROM required_by_sku required CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT inventory.id, inventory.sku_id, inventory.created_at FROM card_secret_inventory inventory WHERE inventory.sku_id = required.sku_id AND inventory.status = 'UNUSED' ORDER BY inventory.created_at ASC, inventory.id ASC LIMIT required.required_count FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) picked ), available_ranked AS ( SELECT locked_cards.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY locked_cards.sku_id ORDER BY locked_cards.created_at ASC, locked_cards.id ASC ) AS sku_available_rank FROM locked_cards ), matched AS ( SELECT needed_ranked.delivery_id, needed_ranked.order_no, needed_ranked.user_id, needed_ranked.sku_id, available_ranked.id AS card_secret_id FROM needed_ranked INNER JOIN available_ranked ON available_ranked.sku_id = needed_ranked.sku_id AND available_ranked.sku_available_rank = needed_ranked.sku_need_rank ), matched_counts AS ( SELECT needed_ranked.order_no, needed_ranked.user_id, needed_ranked.sku_id, COUNT(matched.card_secret_id)::int AS matched_count FROM needed_ranked LEFT JOIN matched ON matched.order_no = needed_ranked.order_no AND matched.user_id = needed_ranked.user_id AND matched.sku_id = needed_ranked.sku_id AND matched.delivery_id = needed_ranked.delivery_id GROUP BY needed_ranked.order_no, needed_ranked.user_id, needed_ranked.sku_id ), missing_counts AS ( SELECT requested.order_no, requested.user_id, requested.sku_id, GREATEST(requested.required_count - existing.existing_count, 0)::int AS missing_count, COALESCE(matched_counts.matched_count, 0)::int AS matched_count FROM requested INNER JOIN existing ON existing.order_no = requested.order_no AND existing.user_id = requested.user_id AND existing.sku_id = requested.sku_id LEFT JOIN matched_counts ON matched_counts.order_no = requested.order_no AND matched_counts.user_id = requested.user_id AND matched_counts.sku_id = requested.sku_id ), shortage_orders AS ( SELECT DISTINCT order_no, user_id FROM missing_counts WHERE missing_count > matched_count ), deliverable AS ( SELECT matched.* FROM matched WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shortage_orders shortage WHERE shortage.order_no = matched.order_no AND shortage.user_id = matched.user_id ) ), updated_cards AS ( UPDATE card_secret_inventory inventory SET status = 'SOLD', order_no = deliverable.order_no, user_id = deliverable.user_id, sold_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), version = inventory.version + 1 FROM deliverable WHERE inventory.id = deliverable.card_secret_id AND inventory.status = 'UNUSED' RETURNING inventory.id AS card_secret_id, inventory.sku_id, deliverable.delivery_id, deliverable.order_no, deliverable.user_id ), inserted_delivery AS ( INSERT INTO order_card_secret_delivery ( id, order_no, user_id, sku_id, card_secret_id, status, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT updated.delivery_id, updated.order_no, updated.user_id, updated.sku_id, updated.card_secret_id, 'DELIVERED', NOW(), NOW(), NOW() FROM updated_cards updated ON CONFLICT (card_secret_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING order_no, user_id, sku_id, card_secret_id ), inserted_counts AS ( SELECT requested.order_no, requested.user_id, requested.sku_id, COUNT(inserted_delivery.card_secret_id)::int AS newly_delivered_count FROM requested LEFT JOIN inserted_delivery ON inserted_delivery.order_no = requested.order_no AND inserted_delivery.user_id = requested.user_id AND inserted_delivery.sku_id = requested.sku_id GROUP BY requested.order_no, requested.user_id, requested.sku_id ) SELECT requested.order_no AS "orderNo", requested.user_id AS "userId", requested.sku_id_hex AS "skuId", requested.sku_name AS "skuName", requested.required_count AS "requiredCount", COALESCE(existing.existing_count, 0)::int AS "existingCount", COALESCE(inserted_counts.newly_delivered_count, 0)::int AS "newlyDeliveredCount", (COALESCE(existing.existing_count, 0) + COALESCE(inserted_counts.newly_delivered_count, 0))::int AS "deliveredCount", GREATEST( requested.required_count - COALESCE(existing.existing_count, 0) - COALESCE(inserted_counts.newly_delivered_count, 0), 0 )::int AS "shortageCount" FROM requested LEFT JOIN existing ON existing.order_no = requested.order_no AND existing.user_id = requested.user_id AND existing.sku_id = requested.sku_id LEFT JOIN inserted_counts ON inserted_counts.order_no = requested.order_no AND inserted_counts.user_id = requested.user_id AND inserted_counts.sku_id = requested.sku_id ORDER BY requested.order_no ASC, requested.sku_id_hex ASC

SELECT delivery.order_no AS "orderNo", delivery.user_id AS "userId", encode(delivery.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", to_base62(delivery.card_secret_id) AS "cardSecretId", inventory.secret_ciphertext AS "secretCiphertext", inventory.secret_nonce AS "secretNonce", inventory.secret_key_version AS "secretKeyVersion", delivery.delivered_at AS "deliveredAt" FROM order_card_secret_delivery delivery INNER JOIN card_secret_inventory inventory ON inventory.id = delivery.card_secret_id WHERE delivery.order_no = #{orderNo} AND delivery.user_id = #{userId} AND delivery.status = 'DELIVERED' ORDER BY delivery.sku_id ASC, delivery.delivered_at ASC, delivery.id ASC
